package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ModuleI18nRepoPG implements ModuleI18nRepository.
type ModuleI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r ModuleI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.ModuleI18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO module_i18n (module_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (module_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description`,
		entry.ModuleID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Description)
	return err
}

func (r ModuleI18nRepoPG) ListByModule(ctx context.Context, moduleID string) ([]domain.ModuleI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT mi.module_id, mi.i18n_id, i.language, mi.title, mi.description
FROM module_i18n mi
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = mi.i18n_id
WHERE mi.module_id=$1
ORDER BY i.language`, moduleID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.ModuleI18n{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.ModuleI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&entry.ModuleID, &entry.I18nID, &entry.Language, &entry.Title, &entry.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r ModuleI18nRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, moduleID string, i18nID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM module_i18n WHERE module_id=$1 AND i18n_id=$2`, moduleID, i18nID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.ModuleI18nRepository = (*ModuleI18nRepoPG)(nil)
